Backend Engineer - Vantage Quill

About the role
Vantage Quill processes insurance claims in near real time. You will join the platform team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build event-driven backend services
- Maintain data stores and migrations
- Ship through automated pipelines

Requirements
- Java and Spring Boot
- PostgreSQL experience
- Apache Kafka for event streaming
- Docker
- Cloud experience on AWS
- REST API design

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- Terraform

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
